en.hubeali: H 14599 – Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Amro Bin Usman, from Abdullah Bin Al-Mugheira, from Talha Bin Zayd, who has narrated the following:
Abu Abdullahasws regarding the Statement of the Highazwj:
“[7:165] So when they neglected what they had been reminded of, We delivered those who forbade evil”.

He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There were of three types – A type who were with the commands and they commanded others, so they were Rescued; and a type who were with the commands but they did not command others, so they were metamorphosed as particles; and a type who were not with the command and did not command others, so they perished’.
en.sarwar: 151. Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Amro Bin Usman, from Abdullah Bin Al-Mugheira, from Talha Bin Zayd, who has narrated the following:
Abu Abdullah (a.s.) regarding the Statement of the High (azwj): “[7:165]
So when they neglected what they had been reminded of, We delivered those who forbade evil”.

He (a.s.) said: ‘There were of three types – A type who were with the commands and they commanded others, so they were Rescued; and a type who were with the commands but they did not command others, so they were metamorphosed as particles; and a type who were not with the command and did not command others, so they perished’.
